question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A meal that is usually taken late in the morning that combines a late breakfast and an early lunch
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Brunch'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct word** that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is 2) Brunch.
 
• **Brunch** is a combination of the words "breakfast" and "lunch."
 
• It refers to a meal that is typically taken later in the morning or early afternoon, combining elements of both breakfast and lunch.
 
• **Brunch **usually includes a variety of dishes such as eggs, bread, fruits, salads, and sometimes even heavier items like meats or pastas.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Brunch'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Snacks: **refer to small portions of food eaten between meals or as a light meal. (नाश्ता)
 
• **Breakfast: **refers to the first meal of the day, typically eaten in the morning. (नाश्ता)
 
• **Lunch: **refers to a meal eaten in the middle of the day, usually around noon or early afternoon. (दोपहर का भोजन)
